mission.goal: Sign in to Memos with the throwaway account (username ghost-test, password HauntTest123!), write the note "Haunt was here 20261124-214137" and save it
mission.requirement: MEMOS-1: WHEN a signed-in user types a note in the note editor and activates Save, THE Memos application SHALL add a new memo with that text at the top of the memo list. The new memo SHALL appear without the user leaving the page.
mission.successCheck: A saved memo card shows exactly the text "Haunt was here 20261124-214137", and the note editor does not count

findings.title: Keyboard focus is trapped in a text box
findings.evidence: Keyboard focus could not leave the text box "Any thoughts..." (role textbox). Tab (50 presses), Shift+Tab (1 press) and Escape (1 press) left focus on it. Tab and Shift+Tab never moved focus away. Escape pressed twice did free focus: it moved focus to another control. This exit is undocumented: no text on the page and no announcement says that Escape works. Nothing was announced while focus was stuck.
